title: Physical AC1027 WIPEOUTVARIABLES writer bridge
scope: The hash-bound AC1027 direct-NOD WIPEOUTVARIABLES witness is imported and its exact source frame, owner, reactor, XDictionary-missing flag, and display-frame value are checked. The captured typed object seeds a locally authored dependency-closed DWG wrapper; that wrapper is re-imported and its selected object is written to ASCII and Binary DXF with refusal, destination-preservation, retry, and typed-rooted-readback checks. This does not convert the physical drawing or qualify native wipeout rendering.

physicalWitness.readLimitations: The witness reports two HEADER integrity observations (expected/observed 822/826 and 844/1583); this does not qualify whole-source output.

wrapper.kind: locally authored AC1027 DWG generated in the focused selector
wrapper.fieldSource: The physical object's display frame and common metadata seed the wrapper record. The source owner/reactor NOD target is remapped to the wrapper's NOD while preserving the direct owner/reactor roles.
checks: physical source frame and typed owner/profile proof
root entry, object owner, reactor and display-frame readback
wrong owner/reactor, altered root, invalid display-mode and cross-revision refusal
wrapper.strictness: AC1027 whole-source strict qualification remains closed. The bounded selected-object control uses the legacy read-completeness setting and independently verifies the emitted NOD/object graph.
wrapper.fixturePolicy: The wrapper DWG and ASCII/Binary DXF outputs are temporary locally authored controls and are removed after execution. The physical source is read-only and no drawing fixture was committed.

validation.result: passed; physical witness import and source-frame audit, wrapper re-import, ASCII/Binary output checks, refusal/retry and typed readback

nonClaims: No physical-source whole-drawing DXF output was attempted as a success claim; the source carries unrelated HEADER integrity observations.
The wrapper output is selected-object evidence and does not prove byte-preserving physical conversion.
No native AutoCAD, LibreCAD, LibreCAD_3, FreeCAD, or independent rendering/plotting acceptance was run.
No broader producer, version, mode, or support claim follows from this witness.
